title: Estate duplicates QDW final routing/verification authority
resolution: Sandbox remains incubator; graduate policy math/contracts, disable EstateRouter/EstateVerificationService as production authorities.

title: Forge verification trusts caller-authored passed boolean
resolution: VerificationCertificateRef + resolver bound to invocation/output; no passed boolean.

title: Dell recommendation would create dual final-route truth if consumed literally
resolution: Dell emits ADVISORY candidate snapshot; QDW HotSwap remains final route.

title: Unknown output token price is currently coerced to zero in workload cost
resolution: If output tokens > 0 and output price is unknown, total cost is unknown; frozen regression included.

title: GitGoblin exporter targets legacy VentureLab/Cuntgoblin schema
resolution: Versioned QDW ObservationBatch and OpportunityProposal exporter.

title: Current QDW Route pricing cannot represent Forge per-call assets without fabrication
resolution: Generalize Route with fixed_request_cost_usd and persist it.

title: External outage can be confused with a legitimate zero-candidate result
resolution: Shared ExternalStatus; UNAVAILABLE/STALE/OK_EMPTY are distinct and contract-tested.

title: Forge asset posterior and QDW task posterior represent different populations
resolution: Forge profile may seed a sourced prior feature only; QDW maintains independent task-cell posterior.

title: Moving repository heads would make certified federation non-reproducible
resolution: Pin exact SHAs; automated pin upgrades require protocol diff + full suite.
